mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased cost of capital and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which is associated with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 142500 and UNRATE < 5.0 and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth above 16500 billion and housing starts above 1150 thousand), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and increased risk of a market correction.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 16500 and HOUST > 1150 and 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 238 signals elevated inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the expectation of monetary tightening and reduced real returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 238 and 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger industrial output indicates a growing economy and improved corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 106 and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a robust economy with strong demand and supply, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 108 and HOUST > 1150 and 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 108), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained economic growth and improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 108 and 60-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
